name: AppFolio Realm-X
description: Use Claude to get real work done in AppFolio. Go deep with data analysis and create reports and presentations, build and trigger complex workflows to run in AppFolio, and drive actions across leasing, maintenance, accounting, and communications. Your AppFolio user permissions securely govern all activity. Through this connector Claude gets more than just API access – it can talk agent-to-agent with Realm-X and handle multi-step processes from prompt to completion. Extend your AppFolio experience to Claude and get work done wherever you work best.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AppFolio Realm-X to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AppFolio Realm-X to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.appfolio.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AppFolio Realm-X MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AppFolio Realm-X provides these MCP tools: chat.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AppFolio Realm-X?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AppFolio Realm-X in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does AppFolio Realm-X MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AppFolio Realm-X requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AppFolio Realm-X is developed by AppFolio, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
